data.define: Used to say that something is only okay, not special.
data.vi: Tầm tầm, chẳng có gì hay

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss the meeting was 'mid'.

publish.title: What does "mid" mean?
publish.value: Mid = Just average, not good. Example: "The movie was mid, honestly." (very casual English, US).
